verdict.rationale: Working Copy's first-party manual describes a built-in Repository Agent that users direct through conversation to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That maps one-to-one onto every element of the story, and the homepage also advertises a Code Agent. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of agent behavior and limits (model, permissions, review of changes before commit/push), independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
